subject: POC onboarding: trial roadmap, success criteria & owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karen Wu <karen.wu@finwise.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-08T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC onboarding: trial roadmap, success criteria & owners

Hi Karen — thanks again for today's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Summary of call
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference latency and cost profile for FinWise fraud-detection inference at 2k reqs/min with 512-token average.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for synchronous scoring at 5 concurrent clients during peak windows;
  2) Integration end-to-end with your preproc pipeline and secure VPC peering;
  3) No material accuracy regression vs baseline model on the provided eval set (AUC drop <= 0.5%);
  4) Cost projection for production at 1M monthly queries under $X per 1k tokens (TBD after baseline run).

Proposed POC scope & timeline (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, data access, security review, baseline metrics collection (Owner: FinWise procurement/Karen + Marissa)
- Week 1: infra setup (VPC peering, keys), model selection and perf tuning (Owner: Jonas)
- Week 2: run workloads, collect latency/cost metrics, run eval set, iterate (Owner: Jonas + Marissa)
- Week 3: final readout, documentation, and recommendations (Owner: Dylan)

Weekly cadence
- 30m syncs on Tuesdays 10:00 AM PT (technical progress) + Friday async readout via shared doc.

Immediate asks for your team
1) Confirm the test dataset delivery ETA (CSV or S3 link).
2) Confirm SOC 2 artifacts we should expect or point of contact for security questionnaire.
3) Approve kickoff window: next Monday (2027-09-13) or Wednesday (2027-09-15).

I've attached a short POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx with the above criteria and a blank gating table for sign-off. If that looks good I will schedule the kickoff and invite the working group.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet)

2) Throughput: the 2k reqs/min target is the peak we care about; can you confirm sustained QPS and expected CPU/GPU footprint? If you can provide an initial estimate that will help us scope the infra.
3) Data: we can deliver a sanitized eval set by EOD Friday (2027-09-10). It's a CSV with 20k rows. Any specific schema we should expect?

Kickoff: Wednesday (09/15) works better for our ops. Can you make that the target?

Thanks,
Karen

Date: 2027-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC onboarding: trial roadmap, success criteria & owners

Marissa — notes below after an initial perf sketch: 

Technical readout (initial)
- Baseline: 1xA10g (or equivalent) can sustain ~700-900 reqs/min for the default fp16 variant with 512 tokens at ~95th %-tile latency ~260-320ms depending on batch strategy.
- Recommendation: run two parallel instances (auto-scaling) with continuous batching + KV cache. Use a quantized int8 model variant (Q8) to target <=250ms 95th% under typical burst patterns.
- Expected footprint for 2k reqs/min: 3xA10g equivalent nodes with auto-scaling buffer (we can revisit after baseline run).

Open items for SOC/Network
- Need VPC peering details and allowed CIDR ranges for FinWise.
- We can provide SOC 2 summary pack — Mina, can you produce a 1-page vendor controls summary and confirm sharing rules?

Deliverables I will produce by Tues 2027-09-14
- Perf run plan (simple harness + payload profile)
- Model variants to test (fp16, Q8), expected perf deltas
- Arch diagram for the POC (arch-diagram.pdf)

I'll mark the items I own in the shared gating spreadsheet.

— Jonas
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
